items.source: The merging algorithm ensures that duplicates are removed from the list and that the resulting set of merged listeners is sorted according to the semantics of AnnotationAwareOrderComparator. If a listener implements Ordered or is annotated with @Order it can influence the position in which it is merged with the defaults; otherwise, locally declared listeners will simply be appended to the list of default listeners when merged.
items.translation: 合并算法确保从列表中移除重复项，并且根据 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator 的语义对合并后的监听器集合进行排序。如果监听器实现了 Ordered 接口或标注了 @Order，则可以影响其合并到默认监听器时的位置；否则，本地声明的监听器在合并时将被简单地追加到默认监听器列表之后。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether explicitly declared listeners are merged with the default listeners when @TestExecutionListeners is declared on a class that does not inherit listeners from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 枚举 模式，用于规定当在类上声明了 @TestExecutionListeners 且该类未从父类或外部类继承监听器时，显式声明的监听器是否与默认监听器合并。
